system.description:
With an intent stare and the words of fire's creation, the thaumaturge causes a victim to burst into rapidly combusting flame that clings until smothered.

Engulf takes a single action; challenge your Mental Traits against the target's Physical Traits. On a win the victim bursts into flame for two levels of aggravated damage, and suffers an additional aggravated level at the end of every turn until they take a full action to smother the fire. You may Engulf a target again on successive turns for cumulative initial damage, though the ongoing fire still inflicts only one level per following turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
